name: Schedule adherence and trends
summary: An adherence score per stage and its roll-ups, scheduled trend lines on progress charts, and exporting actual trends.

roles.note: The seed catalog has no schedule-specific permission strings. Who may upload or edit schedules is unknown (DEC-010 covers related edit rights).

nfr.statement: How current adherence scores must be after new progress or a schedule change.
nfr.open_question: Are scores recalculated on every change, or nightly?

requirements.title: Schedule adherence score
requirements.statement: Each project stage gets an adherence score from its available data points. Scores are normalised and averaged up to category, hierarchy, project and global levels, and each score maps to a status and colour.
requirements.rationale: No adherence-score code was found on api-2d-progress origin/track-3d (2026-10-29). This is a PRD candidate, not current behaviour.

acceptance_criteria.then: It follows the PRD's scoring logic
Each score shows its status and colour

requirements.title: Scheduled trend lines and actual-trend export
requirements.statement: Users can turn scheduled trend lines on or off on progress charts, and export actual progress trends to Excel. The export leaves out scheduled trends.

acceptance_criteria.given: A stage with planned start and end dates
acceptance_criteria.when: The user turns on scheduled trends
acceptance_criteria.then: The scheduled trend line appears on the chart

acceptance_criteria.given: The user exports actual progress trends
acceptance_criteria.then: They get an Excel file with actual trends only
